listing.name: Shadow of the Colossus — sotc-vibe-pc (LightVelox)
listing.summary: This uses static EE/XFF translation with an IOP interpreter and runtime device emulation. Check the progress guide for the exact gameplay and playthrough limits. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PAL SCES53326 v1.00 ISO.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the prebuilt Windows package with your own PALv1.00 disc. The project also documents local code generation and source building.
